resources.string: Run each tap once in the background using this repository, branch and saved connection/account. Results are saved here and shown in notifications when allowed. Interrupted runs require another tap. You can revoke this authorization here.
Shortcut action finished. Open repository actions to review the result.
Shortcut needs attention. Open repository actions to review its state before trying again.
Execution was interrupted. It will not run again automatically. Review the repository before tapping again.
Saved shortcut results cannot be read. Authorization remains separate.
Delete the saved launcher shortcut and callback execution results. Their authorizations remain unchanged. Interrupted actions will not run again automatically.
